title: Yearbook and Recipe
author: Jonah Thornbury
blurb: Rosalind Sterling, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
